insights.one_liner: Amsterdam tech start-up building autonomous electric construction robots; IND sponsor with mostly entry-level engineering roles in English.

culture.text: Builds its own autonomous, electric robots using robotics, software and machine vision to automate construction-site work.
Open roles are mostly hardware and engineering (4 of 6), plus 2 in recruiting, mainly in Amsterdam with one in Appingedam.

open.text: Monumental Works B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
All 6 of its jobs here are open to non-Dutch speakers, and 5 are entry-level.

growth.text: Says its robots are now being deployed on real construction sites.
